title: Le Studio 30a | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
meta_description: Le Studio 30a — a condominium in Seacrest Beach, Florida. 6 guests · 1 bedroom · 1 bathroom. Book direct with Stay on 30a.
description_expanded: Welcome to 'Le Studio 30A', one of our largest newly renovated studio retreats in Seacrest Beach and the perfect place to experience everything that makes 30A so special. Ideally located between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, this beautifully refreshed coastal hideaway puts you in the center of one of the most desirable and walkable beach communities on Florida's Emerald Coast.Thoughtfully designed to maximize both comfort and space, Le Studio 30A offers an open, airy layout with stylish coastal finishes, all-new furnishings, a plush king bed, custom built-in twin-over-twin bunk bed, and queen sleeper sofa. Unlike many studios in the area, you'll also enjoy the convenience of a kitchenette and dedicated dining space, creating a comfortable retreat for couples, small families, or friends looking for an effortless beach getaway.Mornings begin with a short stroll to the private deeded beach access, where sugar-white sand and crystal-clear Gulf waters await. Spend your afternoons lounging by one of the community pools, soaking in the hot tub, or exploring the scenic bike paths of 30A on the two complimentary bikes provided for your stay.The location is truly hard to beat. Just steps from your door, you'll find local favorites at Peddlers Pavilion along with shopping, dining, and entertainment. A leisurely walk takes you to the iconic streets of Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, where charming architecture, boutique shops, award-winning restaurants, and vibrant gathering spaces create the quintessential 30A experience.Whether you're here for a romantic escape, a family beach vacation, or a long weekend by the Gulf, Le Studio 30A combines an unbeatable location, exceptional amenities, and one of the most spacious studio layouts in Seacrest Beach to create a stay you'll be talking about long after you've returned home.STUDIO CONDOProfessionally decorated condo with luxurious touches create a relaxing atmosphere.Smart TV allows guests to wind down and watch a movie after a long day at the beach.Kitchenette comes complete with a Keurig/Drip coffee maker, toaster oven, dishes, electric cooktop, and mini refrigerator/freezer- making it easy to make a delicious breakfast, heat up leftovers or pick up a dinner from downstairs and stay in.Studio comes with the use of two backpack style beach chairs that guests are welcome to take to the beach, as well as beach towels!ACCOMMODATIONSLe Studio 30a accommodates up to 6 people:Bed 1: KingBed 2: Twin/Twin BunkBed 3: Queen Sofa SleeperWHAT WE OFFERA STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIESBody WashShampooConditionerHand SoapToilet PaperDish SoapLaundry DetergentPaper TowelsTrash BagsDish SpongeBath TowelsBed LinensPool TowelsWELCOME BUNDLECoffee Grounds2 Keurig PodsPopcornOlive OilFiji WaterPARKINGParking access available in front of and behind building.We provide 2 bikes for your convenience!FEATURESAccess to zero entry pool & hot tub located steps from the studioElectric cooktop + Pots/PansBunk bedGas grills by pool areaComplimentary beach tram to the beachAccess to restaurants, market, shops, and entertainment steps from studio2 bikes for biking along 30AComplimentary wifiSeasonal events thrown by Seacrest and neighboring beaches- Rosemary & Alys BeachCredit card operated Washer and dryer machines are located right outside studio, making it easy to wash any items during your stayPrivate Deeded Beach Access**Due to the Hurricane the private beach access will remain closed until the necessary repairs can be evaluated and completed and the structure is deemed safe for use.NEARBY BEACH ACCESSSeacrest Beach (0.25 mile west of Condo) is a deeded beach access. Private beach access for guests residing at The Village is through the Sunset Beach community. From Peddler's Pavilion (shopping area in front of The Village) turn right onto 30A. You'll pass High Pointe Resort House on your left. The beach access is shortly thereafter on the left side of 30A (directly across from the Seacrest Beach entrance). This is a monitored, private access where guests 13 years of age and older will be required to wear a wristband to gain entry. PLEASE NOTE: Golf carts, bikes, skateboards and roller blades are not allowed through the beach access. Strollers are permitted through the beach access as long as they are used to transport children and not beach gear. Beach tents are not permitted on any private beach access along 30A.Inlet Beach (1.3 mile east of Condo). Turn right at the light at the intersection of 30A and Highway 98. In approximately 0.4 miles turn right onto Orange Street (you will see the sign for "public beach access"). At the stop sign the road will T, turn right or left to park. This beach access is fully equipped with restrooms and outdoor shower area; this beach is also monitored by lifeguards in the high season. Wheeled coolers, wagons and beach tents are permitted at the public beach access. Bike racks are located near the public beach access, as well.TRAM INFOFree beach tram is available to all guest(s) of The Village from March 1st– October 31st from 9am CST through 5:30pm CST. Tram departs from The Village pool area near Building H every 20 minutes. All guests 13 years of age and older will need to wear wristbands to access the tram. PLEASE NOTE: The tram does not operate during inclement weather.HOUSE RULES*Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM*Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises.*No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited.*No parties or events.*Complimentary bikes (2) provided. Waiver must be completed for bike lock code.*During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi.*Amenity Wristbands: In the condo in the kitchen area, you will find "The Village" wristbands for your use. Each guest 13 years of age and older will need to wear a wristband to be able to access the following areas: the private beach access through Sunset Beach, The Village tram, & the pool at The Village. Prior to departure please return all wristbands to their proper place (guests will be charged a fee of $25 for each missing wristband).IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVALAll guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie".Other things to note
